decision.reason: [ev-924a17cf8cd5] only lists "You're running Crossplane v1.20" as a prerequisite in the v2 upgrade guide. It doesn't say what happens if you upgrade from another version: no version gate, no failing install or hook, and no unsupported-path warning. So "upgrade-blocked" (critical) claims more than the evidence supports, and so does its "v1.20 or later" wording, since the text names only v1.20. Deciding the consequence needs evidence of what actually happens when you upgrade to v2.0.0 from a version other than v1.20, such as an enforced version check, a documented failure, or a required step-by-step upgrade path.
